summary: CLOUDOFFICE AS (org. no. 987 255 684) is a private limited company (AS) based in Tønsberg, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-09-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.100 (Dataprogrammeringstjenester); it has 6 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 8.3 m and net income was NOK 1.6 m. CEO: Roar Bettum; board chair: Roar Bettum; auditor: RE REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 636700F81Q0VBMF5VE31, ultimate parent BETTUM HOLDING AS.
